payload.description: Raw window must be an exact integer in -3..6 inclusive. Missing or null window is invalid. Accepts only exact integers (not bool/float/strings). Always result={accepted:boolean, window:original if accepted else null}; invalid/missing return false/null without exceptions or coercion. Target typed inputs interface requires selected-runner support; unapproved draft, not submitted or activated.
